og_title: Top House Democrats ask AI labs to report safety incidents to Congress within 48 hours | Warning Shots
og_desc: Pallone, Lofgren and Raskin want a full accounting by Nov 11 and 24-hour notice when critical infrastructure is involved. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 41% of the last 12 months' real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 165 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 29, 6:50 PM ET.
